```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
con = DBI::dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
)

listings = DBI::dbReadTable(
  con, "listings"
) |> tibble::as_tibble()

availability = DBI::dbReadTable(
  con, "availability_monthly"
) |> tibble::as_tibble()

reviews = DBI::dbReadTable(
  con, "reviews_monthly"
) |> tibble::as_tibble()

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```


## Task 1

```{r task 1}

# Count listings for each host across all three cities
host_counts = listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listing_count")

listings_with_host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

# A1: Number of hosts with 10 or more listings
a1_hosts = host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listing_count >= 10) |>
  nrow()

a1_hosts

# A2: Percent of Chicago listings held by those hosts
a2_chicago = listings_with_host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    percent_of_listings = 100 * mean(host_listing_count >= 10)
  )

a2_chicago

```

## Task 2

```{r task 2}
# Filter value entire homes for family of four, calculate price_per_person
task2_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_listings = dplyr::n(),
    median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 20)

# [A3] Columbus neighbourhood with lowest median price per person
a3_columbus_lowest = task2_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person) |>
  dplyr::slice(1)

a3_columbus_lowest
```

## Task 3

```{r task 3}
task3_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# A4 Median estimated revenue of Twin Cities entire homes
a4_twin_cities_rev = task3_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt")

a4_twin_cities_rev
```

## Task 4

```{r task 4}
# Flag top 10% revenue listings per city and calculate concentration
task4_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    row_num = dplyr::row_number(),
    is_top_10pct = row_num <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_rev = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    top10_rev = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10pct], na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_revenue_top10 = (top10_rev / total_rev) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#A5 
a5_columbus_pct = task4_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus")

a5_columbus_pct

```

## Task 5

```{r task 5}
# Filter October 2026 availability and join with entire homes
oct2026_avail = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

task5_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(oct2026_avail, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    mostly_taken_share = mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(mostly_taken_share)

# [A6] City with lowest share and [A7] that share
a6_a7_lowest_share = task5_summary |>
  dplyr::slice(1)

a6_a7_lowest_share
```

## Task 6

```{r task 6}
# Join reviews to listings for July 2025 – June 2026 and sum reviews per month

task6_monthly_reviews = reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(listings, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Filter Twin Cities and find busiest & quietest months
tc_monthly = task6_monthly_reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

# [A8] Twin Cities busiest month
a8_busiest_month = tc_monthly |> dplyr::slice(1)

# [A9] Ratio of busiest month to quietest month
a9_ratio = max(tc_monthly$total_reviews) / min(tc_monthly$total_reviews)

a8_busiest_month
a9_ratio
```

## Task 7

```{r task 7}
# Calculate median price & rating for superhosts vs non-superhosts for entire homes
task7_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# [B1] Calculate Superhost price premiums per city 
b1_premiums = task7_summary |>
  dplyr::select(city, host_is_superhost, median_price) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = host_is_superhost, values_from = median_price) |>
  dplyr::mutate(superhost_premium = t - f)

b1_premiums
```

## Task 8

```{r task 8}
# [A10] Listings with no rows in availability using anti_join
missing_avail = listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

a10_missing_count = nrow(missing_avail)

# Identify which city loses the most listings
city_losses = missing_avail |>
  dplyr::count(city, sort = TRUE)

a10_missing_count
city_losses
```
